283806771.description: This lot includes two natural mineral specimens perfect for collectors. The first piece is a polished blue agate geode slice featuring a crystalline druzy center with banded blue, white, and dark quartz formations and a flat base for upright display. The second specimen is a raw matrix rock displaying a cluster of natural white and cream-colored crystal formations embedded in a gray stone base with natural jagged crystal points. Both specimens are in good display condition and showcase authentic geological formations ideal for mineral and gemstone enthusiasts.

283507785.description:
Vintage Eversharp Fountain Pen Set with Mechanical Pencil and Additional Pens
This listing includes a vintage Eversharp writing set featuring a grey fountain pen with a gold cap and a matching mechanical pencil, all housed in the original branded display case. Also part of the collection are four additional vintage fountain pens in various colors and designs, including green with chrome cap, blue with gold trim, dark green with silver cap, and a green and black patterned pen with gold trim. The pens and pencil exhibit age-appropriate wear while remaining structurally intact. The set comes with original boxes, including a textured brown leather case for the Eversharp set and a silver cardboard box for the additional pens.
